## What problem are you trying to solve?

Describe the underlying problem or need — not the solution yet.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches or workarounds you've thought about.

## Does this fit DailySafe's constraints?

DailySafe is local-first with no backend, no accounts, no cloud sync, no ads,
no tracking, and no currency-conversion API (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
Please confirm your request is compatible with those constraints, or explain
why an exception is warranted.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or examples from other apps, if helpful.
